item.title: Ghalibaf: 200 nights of public presence shattered aggressor’s illusion
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf says 200 nights of the Iranian people’s presence on the streets since the beginning of the US-Israeli war of aggression against the country demonstrated that it was the aggressor’s illusion, rather than the Iranian people’s resolve, that has been defeated.
item.content:encoded:

Tehran, IRNA – Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf says 200 nights of the Iranian people’s presence on the streets since the beginning of the US-Israeli war of aggression against the country demonstrated that it was the aggressor’s illusion, rather than the Iranian people’s resolve, that has been defeated.
